description:
RESPONSIBILITIES:


Experience building high-performance, high-availability applications.

Ability to develop creative solutions to difficult problems.

Working directly with developers and product managers to conceptualize, build, test and realize products.

Provides technical expertise to implement and deliver various web and other system projects.

Gathers and analyzes requirements, design and development of the projects.

Organizes and participates in review sessions and contribute to design insights for the projects.

Develops good quality projects in a challenging timeframe and assists other members of the team.



Requirements:


BA/BS in Computer Science or similar field, or equivalent experience

5+ years’ experience with Java

5+ years working in a Java EE environment

MySQL experience and complete understanding

Significant experience and in-depth knowledge of the Spring framework

Significant experience and in-depth knowledge of Hibernate (ORM)

Significant experience and in-depth knowledge of web services and SOA

Significant experience with Object Oriented design and development


PREFERRED SKILLS


Leadership experience

Jetty or Tomcat preferred

NoSQL knowledge is a plus

Previous work experience involving Axis2, Eclipse, JUnit, Maven, Subversion, SCRUM process

E-commerce development a plus

Background in automotive industry preferred (ACES and PIES standards) 




 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
